Title: New guided UI experience to deploy machine learning models in Azure Synapse Analytics (in preview)

Body.Content:
Currently, machine learning models can be manually deployed to dedicated SQL pools in Azure Synapse Analytics for enriching the data with predictions. Today, we are introducing a guided UI experience in the Synapse Studio that enables users to deploy machine learning models from the Azure Machine Learning model registry directly to Azure Synapse for inferencing. Now the models your data scientists create for predictive analytics are easily accessible to all data professionals.

Learn More
